description: The Tacoma News Tribune issued its endorsements for the 31st Legislative District today, and they recommended “Auburn resident Drew Stokesbary, an attorney and policy aide for the King County Council.” Calling Stokesbary a “good candidate,” The News Tribune wrote, “we think Stokesbary better reflects the conservative 31st and would be more likely to part ways … Continued

title: Tacoma News Tribune picks Stokesbary - Re-Elect Drew Stokesbary
